verifications.note: Trade-press planned-projects table, entry 'RH ENERGYTRANS LLC - (1/18) / Project: Risberg Line Project ... Location: Crawford County, PA - Ashtabula County, OH' -- names the pipeline directly and states both endpoints as recorded (start Crawford County PA, end Ashtabula County OH).

"The Risberg Line, a 60-mile pipeline from Crawford County, PA to Erie County, PA and from there across the border into Ashtabula County, OH" -- names the pipeline and states the same start/end counties/states recorded on the sheet.

RH Energytrans (the pipeline's own developer/operator) project page, 'The Risberg Line Route': "the route will begin in the Meadville, PA area [Crawford County] and extend in a northwest direction to Ashtabula County"; elsewhere on the same page: "approximately 28 miles in Erie County, Pennsylvania and Ashtabula County, Ohio." Corroborates start in Crawford/Erie County PA terminating in Ashtabula County, OH.

resolutions.researcher_notes: StartPrefecture/District='Crawford County', StartState/Province='Pennsylvania', EndPrefecture/District='Ashtabula County', EndState/Province='Ohio' (both StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea='United States') confirmed by three independent sources naming the pipeline directly: the Pipeline News/PGJ 'Planned Projects' trade table (explicit 'Location: Crawford County, PA - Ashtabula County, OH'), Marcellus Drilling News's Dec 2019 FERC-startup article ('from Crawford County, PA ... into Ashtabula County, OH'), and the developer RH Energytrans's own project page (route begins Meadville/Crawford County area, terminates in Ashtabula County, OH). Route also passes through Erie County, PA (an intermediate county, not the recorded start/end) per MDN and RH Energytrans -- noted here for completeness, not a conflict with the recorded Start/End.

"Risberg cost roughly $86 million to build and will flow 55 million cubic feet per day" -- post-completion figure, names the pipeline directly, restates $86 million.
"These pipes ... represent the final stages of the $86 million Risberg Pipeline" -- names the pipeline directly, states $86 million, near-completion reporting (Aug 2019).
"the $86 million pipeline gets closer to its end-point in North Kingsville" (Risberg Line, per the article's headline/lede) -- restates $86 million.

resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTRADICTS SHEET: the sheet records SegmentCost=88000000 (USD), but four independent sources (Marcellus Drilling News, twice, in Dec 2018 and Dec 2019; GoErie.com, Aug 2019 near-completion reporting; Ohio River Corridor) each state the project cost as $86 million, not $88 million -- a consistent, repeated figure across pre- and post-construction reporting, not a single outlier. RH Energytrans's own site (https://rhenergytrans.com/learn-more/, already on this row for Length/Operator) also gives 'approximately $86,000,000' as its 'early estimate.' No source found stating $88,000,000. Recording as REFS_ADDED (carrying the sheet's existing $88,000,000 value, per the owed-a-ref rule) rather than UNRESOLVED because sources WERE found and they agree closely with each other -- but flagging this as a real, material discrepancy (~2.3%, $2M) for the orchestrator to route to Update: the recorded $88,000,000 does not match any source found and should likely be corrected to $86,000,000 (USD), sourced to the four refs above plus rhenergytrans.com.
